doc.title: Carmen Leggio interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998

title: Favorite big band recording: Woody Herman 1964
summary: He picks Woody Herman as his favorite big band and calls himself a swing musician.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: If you were to look back on the albums you’ve recorded which was probably your favorite big band?

Woody Herman. 1964. Yeah, I didn’t do too much big band recording, well Maynard naturally was great, everything was great. But well Maynard, a lot of it was exhibition, technical, technique. But with Woody, we could swing. See I like to swing, and I enjoyed the Woody Herman band the best, and Benny Goodman. Well I didn’t record with Benny though, but I enjoyed Benny Goodman’s book, because it swung. So I really am basically a swing musician you know. That’s what I like. Woody Herman is my favorite though.
